line.name: Grand Prize by E.P. Carrillo
line.filler: USA, Ecuador, Nicaragua, Mexico, Dominican Republic (five-country blend)
line.background_text: Debuted at the 2016 IPCPR trade show as part of E.P. Carrillo's new 'Factory Series' - cigars produced at Tabacalera La Alianza but deliberately not carrying the E.P. Carrillo name. Positioned as an affordable, value-priced line.

research_notes: 'La Alianza Grand Prize' (our Mac folder name) is not the line's true name - it's simply 'Grand Prize by E.P. Carrillo,' a separate 'Factory Series' product made at the Tabacalera La Alianza factory but NOT branded/blended as part of the 'La Alianza' retail line. No numeric critic scores found (Cigar Aficionado blocked direct fetch).

research_sources.supports: blend, vitolas, pricing, box counts, Factory Series origin
